clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau doesn't take protein shakes - he says most aren't good for longevity. His example: Jack LaLanne, the fitness icon who was a friend of his.

LaLanne wasn't a vegan. Kevin Trudeau's own words: the supplement LaLanne took almost every day was beef liver.

Organ meat carries nutrients and B vitamins that a processed shake doesn't. Kevin Trudeau's takeaway: real, whole food beats a manufactured substitute.

What's actually in the supplement you take every morning?
